name: find
title: network.find
lead: The instance to send `players` players to (1 unless set), or nil when none has room. With `start`, one is started when none has room.
signature: network.find(options: {label: string, players: number ?, party: (Player | string)?, start: {member: string, slots: number, data: any }?}) → (NetworkStarted ?, string ?)

params.name: options
params.type: {label: string , players: number ?, party: ( Player | string )?, start: {member: string , slots: number , data: any }?}

usedIn.quote: - `network.find{ label, players?, party?, start? }` returns `{id, state}` for the instance to send `players` players to, or nil when no instance has room.
